role: primary-source audit, not experimental discovery evidence

sources.title: Chemically active droplets
sources.use: Thermodynamic framework for diffusion, free energy, reversible chemistry and external chemical work. A closed passive mixture cannot be relabeled as a sustained fuel-driven compartment.

sources.title: Controlling biomolecular condensates via chemical reactions
sources.use: Distinguishes fuel supply and reaction-pathway kinetics from passive association. Published mechanisms are checks and possible starting laws, not discoveries made by this campaign.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dissipative supramolecular materials with a tunable lifetime
sources.use: Identified carbodiimide-driven anhydride chemistry provides an experimental anchor. A phenomenological decrease in hydrolysis inside an assembly would encode protection; it cannot simply be inserted as an emergent mechanism.

sources.title: Liquid spherical shells are a non-equilibrium steady state of active droplets
sources.use: Measured chemical association and fuel-driven shell experiments are relevant, but the reported radial theory presupposes a sphere/shell geometry. It does not by itself establish shape-free 3D genesis. Reproducing the known shell is not a new campaign finding.

sources.title: Interfacial Effects Determine Nonequilibrium Phase Behaviors in Chemically Driven Fluids
sources.use: Local exclusion, pair energy and thermodynamically constrained reversible pathways offer a microscopic alternative. The published square-lattice study supplies concentration-dependent driven kinetics and initializes coexistence geometries. Extending it to unseeded 3D would be a separate law audit and campaign; its existing flux results are not counted here.
sources.code_provenance: Read src/set_rate.py to check the published rate equations. No external source code copied or redistributed. No new lattice campaign has been implemented or run.

next_campaign_requirements: Specify identified material or a microscopically justified particle Hamiltonian, including excluded volume and thermal bath.
Specify both directions of elementary reactions and fuel/waste stoichiometry; account explicitly for reservoir work and heat.
Derive environment-dependent barriers from local interactions or explicit catalyst binding, rather than an inside/outside protection rule.
Preregister shape-free 3D histories, passive and matched-fuel controls, holdout seeds, finite-size/time tests and geometry-independent flux measurements before runs.
Do not treat three parameter knobs of one instability, known literature replication or a picture of a blob as three new life-vessel findings.
